_README: What's New copy, keyed by version string then locale. scripts/asc-apply.mjs reads this and
REFUSES to write it unless the staged version in App Store Connect matches the key, so copy
written for one release can never land on a different one. A populated field is only replaced
with --replace-whats-new, after the before and after have been printed and read.
1.0.1 copy REWRITTEN 2026-10-09. The 2026-09-14 text covered the card rebuild only; 150 commits
landed on main after it (three-part lessons, Atlas clips, streak moment, Home, Trade, Digest).
EVERY CLAIM BELOW WAS CHECKED IN THE TREE BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN. The evidence, in order:
'Every one of the 300 lessons has been rebuilt', 'animated pixel art throughout'
scripts/web-native-structure-parity.mjs walks 300 lessons; scripts/mobile-deck-audit.mjs
and scripts/lesson-art-pin.mjs hold that every deck carries a pixel scene.
'parts: Learn, Vocab and Practice', 'earn its XP on the spot'
src/lib/lesson-segments.ts: 186 lessons three-part, 114 two-part (measured 2026-09-22),
which is why the sentence says 'come in parts' and not 'three parts'. Per-part credit in
src/lib/lesson-segment-credit.ts, pinned by scripts/lesson-segment-credit-regression.mjs.
'carry on from the screen you left'
scripts/lesson-resume-regression.mjs and scripts/lesson-resume-corpus-regression.mjs.
'Atlas walks a diagram through step by step as you tap', 'in the lessons that need it'
src/lib/mobile-lesson/clickthrough/{stage,predict,buildup,place}.ts and parts/scene.ts,
pinned by the four clickthrough pins and scripts/part-scene-pin.mjs. Authored placements
only, so 'the lessons that need it' is the honest scope.
'confetti, a chime and a soft buzz'
src/lib/celebrate.ts feedback('correct'): src/components/correct-confetti.tsx,
assets/sounds/correct_web.m4a, soft haptic. Commit 4f0f7a9.
'amber try again and a Why?'
src/components/lesson-check-bar.tsx (commit c2769c5), scripts/check-bar-pin.mjs.
'Finish a lesson and Atlas catches fire'
src/components/streak-ignite.tsx, mounted at the STREAK step of src/app/lesson.tsx after
every lesson finish. Not 'milestone': it runs every time.
'the streak reminder now knows when you have already practised today'
commit 687b6e7, scripts/streak-reminder-pin.mjs.
'one card shows your streak, your week and today's quests', 'the hero tells you what to do next'
src/app/(tabs)/home.tsx BAND = 'today' (WeekStreak + quests) and the Start/Continue hero,
commits a469619 and 7d653e0.
'Games now lead with today's featured game'    commit 92a8691.
'real company logos', 'exact ticker first', 'confirms every fill'
commits e7c0854 (Elbstream logos, ticker-first search) and 9c5e28e (fill confirmation).
'Digest stories now open with real photos, carry charts and key points, and cite their sources'
commit 41cfc10.
'Onboarding is shorter', 'Atlas guides every screen', 'try compounding for yourself'
commits 2eabbc4 (17 to 16 steps) and e537aa1; scripts/onboarding-atlas-guide-pin.mjs and
scripts/onboarding-try-it-pin.mjs.
the fixes line
28aacfb (34 unfinishable lessons), 3049269 (quiz prompts cut to a last sentence),
4f0f7a9 (slider keeps the guess), b131b90 (Match the Pairs side by side),
d4f1ee6 (blank screen returning to a tab).
WHY ALL FOUR LOCALES ARE IDENTICAL. Nothing in this text is territory-specific: no price, no
currency, no word that differs between these four English storefronts. 'Practised' is the
spelling the app itself uses in src, so it is not a localisation.
NOT SAID, deliberately: nothing about the league, rivals, leaderboards or friends. Every person
in src/lib/people.ts is fabricated and src/app/league.tsx says so on screen. Nothing about the
lesson art pilot by name: it is one lesson, and 'pixel art throughout' already covers what is true.

1.0.1.en-US:
Lessons are now short illustrated cards, built for a phone.

Every one of the 300 lessons has been rebuilt. Where a lesson used to put a wall of text on one screen, you now get a few illustrated cards, one idea at a time, with animated pixel art throughout.

Lessons now come in parts: Learn, Vocab and Practice. Finish a part and you earn its XP on the spot, so a lesson can fit around a bus ride. Close the app mid-lesson and you carry on from the screen you left.

Atlas, your coach, now acts ideas out. In the lessons that need it, Atlas walks a diagram through step by step as you tap, instead of talking over a static chart. Right answers land with confetti, a chime and a soft buzz. Wrong ones get an amber try again and a Why? that explains the mechanism.

Finish a lesson and Atlas catches fire for your streak. The streak reminder now knows when you have already practised today and leaves you alone.

Home has been redesigned around today: one card shows your streak, your week and today's quests, and the hero tells you what to do next. Games now lead with today's featured game.

Trade shows real company logos, puts the exact ticker first in search, and confirms every fill.

Digest stories now open with real photos, carry charts and key points, and cite their sources.

Onboarding is shorter, Atlas guides every screen, and you try compounding for yourself before you are asked to sign up.

Fixes: lessons that could not be finished, quiz questions that lost their numbers, sliders that forgot your guess, Match the Pairs on a small screen, and a blank screen when returning to a tab.
